title: Register internationalized domains without canonical collisions
instruction: Harden DomainLabelRegistry without changing register, lookup, or ascii_name. Names are exact non-empty strings without surrounding whitespace or a trailing root dot. Normalize with NFC then casefold, split labels on dot, reject empty labels, leading/trailing hyphens, control/format/separator characters, invalid IDNA encoding, labels over 63 ASCII bytes, and domains over 253 ASCII characters. The lowercase built-in IDNA encoding is the canonical key. register rejects canonical collisions atomically and preserves the first original spelling and arbitrary value. lookup uses identical canonicalization and raises KeyError only for a valid unknown name. ascii_name returns the stored canonical ASCII form for known names and the validated canonical form for valid unknown names. Failed operations never mutate entries. Add tests and no dependencies.

author_metadata.notes: Wave-4 Unicode lineage combining NFC, casefold, IDNA, label limits, collision protection, and lookup semantics.
